market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $130 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI ~$100. $130 settle requires a 30% rally in ~2 months — would require a meaningful escalation in the US-Iran conflict or sustained Gulf supply disruption. Possible but not base case. Market's 0.315 looks somewhat rich.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Iran conflict escalation risk in May-June
